The task asked for 'CURRENT, verified canonical' rules. data/rules/ carries two accepted verification values, PRIMARY_VERIFIED (252) and OFFICIAL_POLICY_VERIFIED (19), and one rejected value HOLD (5). The five HOLD rules are exactly the five whose status is UNCLEAR, so the CURRENT filter and the verified filter select the same 271 rules. Counted 271.

discrepancies_vs_context.item: MA-MH-SUD-ADMIN is a governance blocker but not a status blocker
discrepancies_vs_context.detail: MA-MH-SUD-ADMIN is recorded as a forbidden rule in the B4-A controls and as a preserved blocker in the post-B4A checkpoint, yet its own record in data/rules/ reads status CURRENT and verification_status PRIMARY_VERIFIED. Nothing in the rule file marks it unusable. Family blocking in this artifact therefore had to be computed from the controller artifacts, not from rule status alone.

discrepancies_vs_context.item: The canonical rules directory was being written to by another lane during measurement
discrepancies_vs_context.detail: data/rules/ held 276 files at the measured commit and 278 on disk by the time measurement finished. The two extra files, MA-RX-FAILOVER-ORAL and MA-RX-WRITTEN-FORMAT, are both Area 2 / Prescription format, both marked status CURRENT and verification_status PRIMARY_VERIFIED, and both carry verification_notes stating that an independent audit is still required. They pass the canonical filter on their face. They began the session untracked and were committed onto a feature branch before it ended; they are still not on main. This artifact excludes them so the numbers are reproducible against the release line, and reports them in section_2.working_tree_rule_delta. A B4-B map locked from a working-tree measurement rather than a pinned one would silently treat unaudited law as canonical headroom.

lightly_tested_rules.definition: canonical rule cited by exactly 1 or 2 RELEASED questions
lightly_tested_rules.why_this_matters: Only 13 canonical rules are wholly untested, so 'untested law' is nearly exhausted as a source of B4-B propositions. The realistic headroom is the thinly tested tail: rules the released bank touches once or twice, where a materially different actor, trigger, exception, timing or documentation consequence is still unexercised. This is a measurement of citation counts, not a judgement that any particular rule has an unexercised proposition left in it.

never_cited_by_any_candidate.note: This is the only wholly unclaimed canonical law in the bank. Of the 13 rules with no RELEASED citation, 9 are already carried by an AUDIT_PENDING candidate, so authoring a B4-B item on them would collide with work already sitting in the pipeline.

section_4_deficit_feasibility_by_area._binding_constraint_note: Family cap headroom is not the binding constraint anywhere: every Area has at least 3x its deficit in usable headroom, and the bank-wide usable headroom of 519 slots is more than six times the 82-item total deficit. The binding constraint is proposition novelty. Only 13 canonical rules are wholly untested bank-wide, so almost every B4-B slot must carry a genuinely new proposition drawn from a rule the released bank already cites. This is a measurement of caps and citations; whether a given rule still holds an unexercised proposition is an authoring judgement the controller and author must make.

What does carry forward is the fact that the prior planner expected roughly 27 percent of a 33-slot tranche to need live authority recheck.
